display_name: Open Banking Consent Flow Stress Simulator
purpose: Monte Carlo stress simulation of PSD2/FAPI 2.0/CDR consent lifecycle FSM (INIT→REDIRECT→AUTH→AUTHORIZED→ACTIVE→FAILED/EXPIRED/REVOKED). Configurable failure probabilities per transition stage, terminal state distribution, ASPSP SCA availability compliance check (95% threshold). Chains from PNR-01 (DORA ICT cascade).
